dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: One prominent, thick white wing bar visible across the greater coverts with high grayscale contrast against the dark wing feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence with sharp, thin white boundary lines along the outer edges of folded flight feathers against darker grey-blue vanes.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: High-contrast rectangular white patch located on the posterior neck, bordered by black plumage above and below.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Highly distinct and multi-layered transition boundary involving a black crown, white nape patch, and black dorsal collar separating the head from the olive-green mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Strong color-contrast boundary between the bright olive-green mantle and the blue-grey hue of the wings and tail.
